rules.key: worth over 750 points a fleet commander must be included
rules.text: If the fleet is worth over 750 points a fleet commander must be included to lead it.

rules.key: As long as at least one Space Marine Battle barge is included
rules.text: As long as at least one Space Marine Battle barge is included you may choose a Master of the Fleet, who will always be assigned to a Battle barge and cannot be assigned to a non-Space Marine ship.
rules.why: Ehdollinen komentajavalinta: riippuu siita mita aluksia laivastossa on. Moottori ei osaa sitoa komentajaa alustyyppiin.

rules.key: you cannot choose to buy Master of the Fleet re-rolls if your fleet is commanded by an Admiral
rules.text: The cost of your re-rolls depends on the commander you choose (ie you cannot choose to buy Master of the Fleet re-rolls if your fleet is commanded by an Admiral).
rules.why: Kaksi erillista re-roll-hinnastoa; valinta on pelaajan. Rivit ovat omissa osioissaan 'Admiral Re-rolls' ja 'Master of the Fleet Re-rolls'.

rules.key: one battleship in your fleet for every three cruisers
rules.text: You may include up to one battleship in your fleet for every three cruisers or battlecruisers.

rules.key: one battlecruiser in your fleet for every cruiser
rules.text: You may include up to one battlecruiser in your fleet for every cruiser.
rules.why: Huomaa: 'for every cruiser' ilman lukusanaa, eli suhde on 1:1 eika 1:2 kuten muissa Imperial-listoissa. Ei jasentynyt ennen 7.9.2026, koska lukusanan paikalle tarttui sanan alku ('cruise' + 'r').

rules.key: escorts in your fleet in squadrons of 2
rules.text: You may include any number of escorts in your fleet in squadrons of 2-6 unless specified (see pg. 13).

rules.key: Space Marine vessels may not be squadroned with non-Space Marine vessels
rules.text: * Space Marine vessels may not be squadroned with non-Space Marine vessels.
rules.why: Skwadronin kokoonpano paatetaan poydalla, ei listassa.

rules.key: No more than two of these vessels (Endurance and Defiant class light cruisers)
rules.text: No more than two of these vessels (Endurance and Defiant class light cruisers) may be taken for every 500 points (or portion thereof) in the fleet.
rules.why: Valvottu 9.9.2026 (kohta 8): kirjasta luettu saanto lisatty build_data.py:n RULE_PICKS-tauluun; resolveFleet tarkistaa sen. per_points pick=Endurance|Defiant. Aiempi puute: Pisterajaan sidottu raja, mutta kohteena kaksi nimettya listariviä eika osio. per_points-tarkistus laskee osion, joten se hyvaksyisi mitka tahansa risteilijat.

rules.key: may only take reserves from other Imperial Navy fleets list NOT Space Marine fleet lists
rules.text: However, it is important to note that despite the inclusion of Space Marine vessels in the fleet list, this is still an Imperial Navy fleet and hence may only take reserves from other Imperial Navy fleets list NOT Space Marine fleet lists.

rules.key: any mix of Fury interceptors and Starhawk bombers
rules.text: Any ship with launch bays may choose to have them launch any mix of Fury interceptors and Starhawk bombers.

rules.key: Some ships may carry Shark assault boats
rules.text: Some ships may carry Shark assault boats at an additional cost.
rules.why: viittaa profiileihin: Emperor s.53, Oberon s.56

rules.key: Ships with torpedo tubes are armed with ordinary torpedoes
rules.text: Ships with torpedo tubes are armed with ordinary torpedoes.
rules.why: Toteava oletus, ei valintaa eika rajoitetta.

rules.key: Imperial Navy fleets choosing reserves from this fleet list cannot choose Space Marine vessels
rules.text: Likewise, Imperial Navy fleets choosing reserves from this fleet list cannot choose Space Marine vessels from it.
rules.why: Osittainen lainauskielto lahdelistan puolelle (lend_ban): tahdella merkityt rivit ovat Space Marine -aluksia (s.41: '* Space Marine vessels may not be squadroned with non-Space Marine vessels'), ja s.15 sanoo saman esimerkkina Gothic Sectorista. Tasan yksi tahti nimen lopussa, koska kaksi tahtea merkitsee Endurancen ja Defiantin (harvinaiset variantit). Loytyi pistokokeessa 20 (siemen 2026091413): Gladius* tarjottiin Bakalle reservina ja laivasto hyvaksyttiin vihreana. Sovellus oli 1.0:sta asti tarjonnut nama kahdeksan rivia reservina jokaiselle Imperial Navy -listalle.

notes: Re-roll-rivit ovat kahdessa osiossa, koska kirjassa on kaksi eri hinnastoa: Admiral 25/75/150 ja Master of the Fleet 25/50/75. Sovellus pitaa ne erillaan, mika vastaa kirjaa.
Rapid Strike Vessel -rivit viittaavat kahteen sivuun kirjassa (esim. 'pg 106 (pg 79)'): saannot ovat sivulla 106 ja profiili alkuperaisen aluksen sivulla. Sovellus kayttaa profiilisivua.
Sivut 42-47 kuuluvat taman listan sivualaan mutta ovat kertomusta (Dominus Astra, Calgar, Rathin henkilokuva). Ne on poistettu nakyvista LORE_SECTIONS-taulussa.
